Neutral masses implied by m/z values and rules

Source: R/adducts.R
impliedMasses.Rd

For an ion with m/z mz formed by a rule with nmol molecules, charge charge and mass shift massdiff, the neutral mass is (abs(charge) * mz - massdiff) / nmol. impliedMasses() computes this for every combination of feature and rule. It is the basic operation of rule-based adduct annotation and is exported for teaching and testing.

Usage

impliedMasses(mz, rules)

Arguments

mz

numeric m/z values.

rules

data.frame with rules in CAMERA's format (see adductRules).

Value

matrix with one row per m/z value and one column per rule.

Examples

rules <- defaultAdductRules("positive")[1:3, ]
impliedMasses(c(170.0445, 192.0275), rules)
#>        [M+H]+  [2M+H]+  [3M+H]+
#> [1,] 169.0372 84.51861 56.34574
#> [2,] 191.0202 95.51011 63.67341
